title: How could engineers build a floating skyscraper that anchors to an asteroid?
angle: Explores the extreme architectural and tension physics of space-tethered mega-structures, revealing how gravity manipulation and ultra-strong carbon materials could one day suspend buildings from the sky.
description: An engaging, scientifically accurate exploration of space-tethered mega-structures, detailing how carbon nanomaterials and orbital mechanics could suspend a skyscraper from the sky.
